sections.body: R is the first completed non-doji candle directly after a completed opposite-colour candle. A bullish R follows a bearish leg; a bearish R follows a bullish leg. n counts additional candles after R: preceding bearish,bearish,bearish → bullish R → bullish F1 → bullish F2 is a 3-candle preceding leg and a success at n=2. Known preceding lengths use the whole observed leg; unknown starts have their own group. All preceding legs includes every reversal, including unknown starts. Choose year, session and preceding leg in the tables. All years + All hours gives overall; a year + All hours gives yearly; All years + a named window gives session; a year + a window gives year-by-session. The All preceding legs row overlaps the disjoint size rows; do not sum it with them. Continuation requires n uninterrupted completed candles with R's close-open sign. An opposite candle or doji is failure. A session/export boundary before classification is unknown. Already-observed short-horizon successes remain counted. Rates use each horizon's known success + failure population; exact numerator, denominator and unknown counts for every cell are in the four CSVs.
sections.title: Read the reversal sequence

sections.body: Event groups use R's completion proxy (when the signal becomes known), rather than its opening or outcome time. Year uses its inferred 18:00-rollover session date. Follow-up continues across named-window endpoints but never across inferred daily sessions or completion barriers. NY wall-time windows: Asia 20:00–02:00; London 02:00–09:00; NY 09:30–16:00; Asia Open 19:30–21:30; NY Open 09:30–10:30; NY AM 10:30–12:30; NY PM 12:30–16:00. Start included, end excluded. Overlapping windows cannot all be summed. 2019 and 2026 have partial coverage. The entire partial final session 2026-09-24 is excluded. Bar coverage is anchored at bar opening, separately from event completion-time groups. Original same-second and identical rows retain source order. OHLC is available; volume, exact completion and contract/roll treatment are unverified. These are descriptive historical frequencies on already-inspected history, without independent forecast validation, iid confidence intervals or trading profitability evidence.
sections.title: Timing, windows and interpretation
